usageNotes: Returns the ordered list of container-level firewall rules for a specific LXC guest; rules are applied in position order (pos field), so sequence matters for policy evaluation. Requires VM.Audit permission on /vms/{vmid} — read-only and safe to call at any time regardless of container run state. Use this before modifying rules to capture current state or to verify a rule was applied correctly after a create/update operation.

examples.summary: List all firewall rules for LXC container 110 on node pve01

tips: Rules are returned in ascending pos order; lower pos values are evaluated first.
The 'enable' field is an integer flag (1 = enabled, 0 = disabled) — a rule present in the list is not necessarily active.
Container-level rules are evaluated after datacenter and node-level firewall policies; check those layers if a rule here appears to have no effect.
An empty array response means no container-level rules are defined — inherited cluster/datacenter rules may still apply if the firewall is enabled on the container.
